communications.subject: Welcome to AudioPeak Sound+!
communications.body: Your AudioPeak Sound+ plan is active! $12.99/month — replacement ear tips/cushions plus annual cable credit. Your plan renews automatically each month. You can cancel anytime, and cancellation takes effect at the end of your current billing period.

communications.subject: Your AudioPeak Sound+ Renewal
communications.body: Your AudioPeak Sound+ plan ($12.99) will renew in 3 days. If you wish to cancel, please do so through your account settings. Cancellation takes effect at the end of the current billing period.

communications.subject: Cancel my Sound+ plan
communications.body: Please cancel my AudioPeak Sound+ plan immediately. I do not want to be charged again.

communications.subject: RE: Cancel my Sound+ plan — Cancellation Confirmed
communications.body: Your cancellation has been processed. As per our terms of service agreed at signup, your cancellation takes effect at the end of your current billing period. Your final replacement-parts shipment for this cycle will still be sent. No further charges will be made after that.

communications.subject: AudioPeak Sound+ — Final Billing
communications.body: Your final AudioPeak Sound+ charge of $12.99 has been processed. This covers your remaining billing period's replacement-parts shipment. Your plan will not renew after this cycle. Thank you for being a subscriber.
